text:
Maya Chen: I want to pilot a small 'listening cohort' alongside the private preview to quickly surface onboarding friction and deployment gaps. thinking ~8 partners, mix of hosted/dedicated. drafting recruitment + success criteria here for ops + eng input.

Jon Reyes: sounds good. do we want industry spread or focus depth?

Maya Chen: spread but prioritize finance + healthcare (regulatory signals). also aim for 50/50 hosted vs private deployments.

Priya Patel: operational capacity question 1: how many hands-on onboarding sessions can CS run per week?

Evan Liu: eng can support 3 deep sessions/week (live ride-alongs). async follow-ups scale more.

Ana Gomez: propose a tight 4-week pace: week 0 kickoff, week 1 instrumentation & smoke, weeks 2-3 iterative feedback sprints, week 4 wrap + retro.

Maya Chen: invite funnel plan: (1) warm/reactive (existing folks), (2) outbound targeted. acceptance goal 25% => invite ~32 to get 8.

Priya Patel: incentives? credits, priority support, early access to features?

Maya Chen: offer $5k infra credit, 3 months priority support, optional joint case study.

Jon Reyes: ops note: need consent + transcript webhook to S3 for analysis. include anonymization step.

Evan Liu: add GDPR consent checkbox in invite flow. store only hashed customer IDs, no PII.

Maya Chen: screening rubric (0-3 each):
- production urgency
- data sensitivity (low/med/high)
- integration complexity
- experimentation appetite (canary/rollouts)
Total >=7 -> candidate.

Ana Gomez: add a behavioral gate: must commit to 3 feedback sessions (pass/fail).

Maya Chen: good — make that explicit on the invite.

eng-bot: reminder: create the DP cohort tracker from /templates/dp-cohort-tracker in the product drive.

Priya Patel: who maintains tracker and handles handoff to CS?

Maya Chen: Product will own the tracker and invites. CS owns onboarding calls & customer SLAs. Owners: Maya (product lead), Priya (CS lead), Evan (eng escalation).

Jon Reyes: feedback cadence idea: weekly 30m sync + biweekly 60m deep review + weekly async digest. attach logs + highlight tickets.

Ana Gomez: artifact: 1-page 'partner pain brief' after week 2 capturing top 3 blockers, impact, and suggested mitigations.

Maya Chen: proposed success criteria (need at least 2 of 3 to mark cohort successful):
- onboarding time < 5 days (kickoff -> smoke pass)
- critical blockers <= 1 after week 4
- customer NPS >= 7 at week 4
- measurable perf/cost improvement >= 10% on one workflow

Priya Patel: can CS mark onboarding stages in tracker? we can ship an automated onboarding_time metric.

Evan Liu: yes. we'll emit telemetry events: `dp.smoke_pass` and `dp.feedback_submitted`. I'll add them this sprint.

Jon Reyes: escape hatch: any P0 triggers an immediate pause of experiments, create a hotfix channel; 48-hour response SLA to triage.

Ana Gomez: timeline suggestion: publish invite next Tue, screen Wed-Thu, notify Fri, kickoff Mon. tight but achievable.

Maya Chen: owners & deadlines:
- Maya: finalize invite copy + tracker (due Mon)
- Priya: confirm incentives/legal + CS calendar windows (due Mon)
- Evan: telemetry + hotfix playbook (due Fri)
- Jon: outreach targets (10) + email drafts (due Tue)
- Ana: feedback templates + 1-page memo template (due Fri)

Priya Patel: legal flagged the case study opt-in language. I'll update and ping Maya.

eng-bot: deploy reminder -> set calendar invites for kickoff sessions after acceptance.

Maya Chen: please react with :thumbsup: when you ack your tasks; i'll lock plan and start outreach.
